units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 1:1">Peah I, 1</cite> <he>כ׳ אב ואם</he> filial respect. Sifra K’dosh. beg.; <cite ref="Kiddushin 31b:2">Kidd. 31ᵇ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:3">Lev. XIX, 3</cite>, a.
<cite ref="Exodus 20:12">Ex. XX, 12</cite>) <he>איזהו מורא ואיזהו כ׳</he> what constitutes filial fear (reverence), and what filial respect?—
Pesik. R. s. 23—24; Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ top אדיין לחצי הכ׳ וכ׳ he has not come up yet to half of the filial duties which the Law implies; a. fr.—2) sweeping, cleansing.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 7:2">Nidd. VII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Niddah 56a:68">56ᵃ</cite>) <he>עד שעת כִּבּוּד</he> up to the time of sweeping; <cite ref="Niddah 3a:24">Nidd. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שעת הכי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 11:3">Treat. S’maḥ. ch. XI</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>כִּיבּוּדִים</he>, <he>כִּבּ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Niddah 56b:14">Nidd. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>בשעת כִּבּוּדֵיהֶם</he> when they are being swept.
